added_lines: or either of the church sacristies god first, st peter’s youth group teens aged 13-17 are invited to come along on the 2nd and 4th friday of each month, 6.00pm-8.00pm in the family room, our lady of lourdes church . november prayer lord god, whose days are without end and whose mercies beyond counting, keep us mindful that life is short and the hour of death unknown. let your spirit guide our days on earth in the ways of holiness and justice, that we may serve you in union with the whole church, sure in faith, strong in hope, perfect in love. and when our earthly dwelling is ended, lead us rejoicing into your kingdom where you live for ever and ever. amen. order of christian funerals,332 drogheda, st peter's
